issue.title: Wire Source audio dock to real fetch + playback
issue.body:
## Summary / context

The drafting **Source audio** dock (`SourceAudioPlayerBar`) is still a decorative stub: play/seek UI exists, but duration/position are hardcoded and nothing loads or plays real source audio.

This was an intentional waiver on **PR #229** (Record tab / drafting UX for #49). Issue **#49** AC covered **source text** (accordion / view source), not source-audio fetch or playback. Nothing currently owns “fetch source audio and play it through the dock.”

Draft **take** recording/playback is a separate lane (#96 / #116 / Record tab work). This ticket is **source** audio only (e.g. BSB or project source).

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Source audio bar looks like a player but does not fetch audio or drive real position/duration.

**Expected:** Selecting a unit in drafting loads available source audio (when we have it), and the dock plays it via the existing playback engine where possible, with honest loading / empty / error UI.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Fetch source audio for the active drafting unit (BSB and/or project source — pick what’s available in API/DB today; document gaps)
- Wire `SourceAudioPlayerBar` (and Bible tab if it shares the same dock/player) to real playback
- Prefer existing playback engine / hooks (`usePlaybackEngine`, `createPlaybackEngine`, verse-audio paths) over a one-off player
- Real duration + position (no hardcoded `0:00` / fake totals)
- Loading, empty (no source audio), and error states in the dock
- Pause/stop when switching unit or leaving the screen (match draft-playback hygiene if already established)

**Out of scope**
- Draft take **recording** / take list UX (already owned elsewhere)
- New waveform product decision (see #96) unless strictly required to play source audio
- iOS

## File pointers & approach

| Area | Path / note |
| --- | --- |
| Dock UI | `src/components/layout/SourceAudioPlayerBar.tsx` |
| Record usage | `src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx` (and DraftingScreen tab wiring) |
| Playback | `src/hooks/usePlaybackEngine.ts`, `src/audio/createPlaybackEngine.ts`, related verse-audio hooks/reducer |
| Design reference | Lovable drafting dock / `tmp/lovable-ux` record + drafting shots (source audio chrome) |
| Related | PR #229 waiver; #49 (source text only); #96 / #116 = draft playback engine epic — **do not** conflate draft takes with source audio |

Suggested approach:
1. Confirm where source audio URIs live today (API sync → SQLite vs on-demand fetch).
2. Add a thin hook or extend existing verse-audio path for **source** asset only.
3. Bind dock controls to engine play/pause/seek + progress.
4. Cover empty/error/loading in UI; add unit tests for wiring/state where practical.
5. Android device QA for actual playback (mic/filesystem not required, but audio playback is native).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source audio for the active unit can be resolved (local path / URI) when the project/API provides it
- [ ] `SourceAudioPlayerBar` play/pause/seek drives **real** playback (not a no-op stub)
- [ ] Displayed duration and position reflect the loaded asset (not hardcoded placeholders)
- [ ] Loading, empty (no audio), and error states are visible and don’t crash the tab
- [ ] Changing unit or leaving drafting stops/clears source playback appropriately
- [ ] Reuses existing playback engine patterns where feasible (no parallel ad-hoc player stack without a clear reason)
- [ ] Unit tests cover new fetch/wiring/reducer behavior where logic lives outside pure UI
- [ ] Distinct from draft-take recording/playback — this ticket does not claim #49/#96 take AC

## Verification / test plan

1. `npm run format:check`
2. `npm run lint`
3. `npm run typecheck`
4. `npm test -- --ci`
5. **Android device/emulator:** open drafting → Record (and Bible if shared) → confirm source dock loads, plays, seeks, shows real times; try a unit with no source audio and a failed load if injectable
6. Confirm draft take record/play still works independently

## Links

- PR (waiver): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/229
- Issue #49 (Record tab; source **text** AC, not source audio): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/49
- Issue #96 (playback engine — draft-oriented): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/96
- Issue #116 (audio recording & playback epic): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/116
- Board: [Fluent Mobile Board (Project 4, view 9)](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9)

## Notes

Orphan follow-up from #229 — file this so source-audio work has an owner ticket before another Record/drafting PR swallows it again. Do not assign `@cursor` unless triage asks for agent pickup.

comments.body: Issue #48 has the requirements for the sequential playback.

## API readiness note (board audit — refreshed)

**Why the API is not complete for this ticket**

The Source audio dock needs **playable source (reference) audio URIs** for the active drafting unit. fluent-api `main` still does not expose source-audio assets. Translator **recording** audio is a separate lane and is also not on `main` yet.

### What exists today (fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb`, 2026-08-06)

- Bible **text** only: `GET /bibles/.../texts`, `POST /bibles/.../bulk-texts`.
- Pericopes: section metadata (FIA/FCBH), **not** audio files.
- No source-audio domain/routes; no DBL audio proxy on `main`.
- DBL work in flight is text/lookup oriented ([#216](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/216), [#230](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/230)–[#233](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/233)); #216 notes “determine audio bible availability” as research, not a shipped endpoint.
- Mobile Prepare-for-Offline already documents: Tier 1 Source Bible Text → Fluent API; **Tier 1 Source Audio → DBL** (`prepareOfflineResourceManifest.ts`). Not implemented as a Fluent contract yet.
- Side channel: mobile’s direct Aquifer client (`AquiferAPI.getBibleText(..., shouldReturnAudioData: true)`) can return chapter `audio.mp3/webm` URLs when Aquifer has them — **not** a fluent-api contract, not wired to `SourceAudioPlayerBar`, and may not match the project’s chosen source Bible.

### What is missing

1. A first-party (or proxied) **source audio catalog + download/stream URLs** keyed by project source Bible / book / chapter / verse (or chapter blob + timestamps).
2. DBL (or chosen provider) ingestion/proxy so mobile does not invent provider auth or URL shapes.
3. Optional: stable offline-friendly URLs/sizes for Prepare Offline Tier 1 Source Audio (shared with #52/#201).

### What needs to be done (fluent-api)

1. Decide provider of truth for project source audio (DBL vs Aquifer vs other) and whether mobile may call the provider directly or must go through fluent-api.
2. Ship endpoints (or documented provider contract) returning playable URIs + duration/size metadata for the active unit.
3. Until then: mobile implements #235 with **mock/fixture URIs** + honest empty/error dock states; swap when API/DB provides real URLs.

Checked against fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb` (2026-08-06). Prior audit was `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).

API dependency filed: [fluent-api#282](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-api/issues/282) — **Expose source/reference audio API for mobile drafting dock**.

On Fluent Project 4 (**Web** board / fluent-api repo), not the Mobile board. Distinct from `/verse-audio` translator recordings.

Tracked under the A+ composite-grades initiative as **P1** (existing product gap — do not duplicate).

Parent: #365

**Note (source audio verse seek):** When the Aquifer API returns `verseTimestamps` of `0` (seen on DEV), seek falls back to chapter start. Chapter play still works; accurate verse-aligned seek needs real timestamps from the API. Tracked as a known limitation on the #235 delivery PR.
